title: Minecraft but the Floor Changes Every Day
description: Every time a day passes, the entire floor changes to a different block.
body:
![Flat terrain, stretching into the distance, each chunk is composed of different blocks, creating a tiling effect](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/1682b796b60f144e02528213e541af47a6b6eb8c_0.webp) ## Overview **This pack must be installed during new world creation!** It can't be used on pre-existing worlds. This is a superflat challenge where at the start of every day, the entire floor changes to a different block. All 3 dimensions have been converted into superflat terrain and are each affected by the floor change. Each dimension contains the structures/mobs needed to beat the game. If you'd like to make a video or content using this pack, go for it! If you do so, you must provide credit to me (Ambiguous Chameleon) and provide a link to this pack in the description and/or comments. Thank you! ## Cheats & Commands
Command Description
/trigger ac.sf_randomizer.change_to_block Changes the floor to the block in your mainhand
/trigger ac.sf_randomizer.disco_chunks Toggles Disco Chunks1. Off by default
/trigger ac.sf_randomizer.enable_tnt Allows TNT to spawn as the floor. Off by default
/trigger ac.sf_randomizer.add_day Moves time forward to the next day, triggering a floor change
/function ac_cheat:uninstall Uninstalls project (data pack version only!)
1 Each chunk will individually choose a block to use for its chunk
